limits: This is not an exhaustive membership roll for either organization.
Bilderberg annual participation and governing-committee membership are separate facts.
2017–2019 and 2022–2026 organizer-hosted rosters are complete for their pages. 2007–2016 archived rosters retain explicit secondary provenance. No annual roster before 2007 is imported.
Bilderberg 2020 and 2021 were cancelled, according to its official overview.
The full source-published Dialog 2022 partial roster is imported, but it is not a complete retreat roster.
Selected 2026 Dialog directory names come from published journalism; no comprehensive current membership or meal-by-meal attendance list is asserted.
The 2015 dinner is separate from Dialog unless new evidence establishes organizational sponsorship.
Jeff Epstein, the former Oracle CFO, must never be merged with Jeffrey Epstein.
Meeting, registration, invitation and correspondence links do not imply agreement, control, knowledge of crimes, or wrongdoing.

Pre-2007 archive lists are labeled unofficial (1958 incomplete), so remain excluded. Scan transcriptions preserve names with source ambiguity: the 2008 Kwasniewski entry omits a given name, and historical royal titles remain distinct from current monarchs.
coverage.aliasPolicy: Known name variants are merged only with matching historical affiliation or unambiguous identity; original listedName is preserved. Ambiguous historical royal titles and incomplete Kwasniewski given name remain explicitly marked. George M. David and George A. David are not merged.
